name: Mary's Looking Glass
summary: Mary's Looking Glass is a discarded hand mirror once treasured by Blind Mary before tragedy claimed her sight and life. Abandoned in the haunted groves of Duskwood, it was scavenged by a roving ghoul before being sought out to complete Viktori Prism'Antras's telescope.

sections.title: A Forsaken Treasure
sections.body: Before her terrible fate, Blind Mary treasured this polished looking glass. Following the horrific incident that cost Mary her eyes and her life, looking upon her reflection became an agonizing reminder of what she had lost. She cast the mirror away behind her barn, leaving it to the encroaching gloom of Duskwood. There it fell into the clutching claws of an Insane Ghoul that wandered the ruined outskirts, carrying the trinket south into the crypts of Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.

sections.title: Eyes to the Heavens
sections.body: In Darkshire, the eccentric stargazer Viktori Prism'Antras dreamed of peering through Duskwood's eternal twilight toward the pristine heavens above. Building his telescope required specialized optical lenses and reflective glass. Upon learning of Mary's abandoned mirror, Viktori enlisted adventurers to hunt down the feral undead prowling the cemetery's ruined chapel, reclaiming the looking glass to serve as an optical reflector in his grand star-viewing machine.

faq.q: Why did Mary throw the looking glass away?
faq.answer: The looking glass was once one of Mary's dearest possessions, but after the violent incident that blinded and killed her, the sight of a mirror brought only sorrow. Unable to bear it, she cast the mirror out behind her family's barn.

faq.q: Who ended up with the mirror after Mary discarded it?
faq.answer: An Insane Ghoul roaming the woods behind Mary's old farmstead scavenged the discarded mirror. The deranged undead eventually took up residence within the abandoned chapel at Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.

faq.q: Why does Viktori Prism'Antras want Mary's looking glass?
faq.answer: Viktori is constructing an elaborate telescope to pierce the gloom of Duskwood and study the stars. He requires a fine reflective surface to direct light through the device, and Mary's preserved glass fits his design perfectly.

faq.q: Where can the Insane Ghoul holding the mirror be found?
faq.answer: The Insane Ghoul lurks in the far southeastern corner of Duskwood, typically haunting the ruined stone chapel inside the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.

angles.text: Engineers can appreciate Viktori's ingenuity in repurposing an antique household mirror into a functional optical reflector for an astronomical viewing device.
Reclaiming relics from the horrors stalking Tranquil Gardens Cemetery brings small measures of closure to Darkshire's beleaguered citizens and aids town projects.
